evidence.observation: Growth-stage pressure baseline ~2.90 Torr, matching purge/ramp behavior
Monotonic pressure rise 2.90->3.175 Torr over ~10 min at constant Ar 100 sccm
MFC steady at setpoint, so rise is not due to increased inlet flow
Thermocouple at 750 °C setpoint with stable heater power ~44%, so rise is not thermal expansion
Sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or portable O2/leak-check) to distinguish air in-leak from exhaust restriction; a pump-down/flow-step test (e.g., drop Ar to 0 and watch whether P decays) would separate seal leak from blockage.
